trial_set: Every phase 3 RCT of orforglipron in type 2 diabetes indexed in PubMed on 2026-09-30 (query: orforglipron[ti] AND "type 2 diabetes"[ti] AND (Clinical Trial, Phase III[pt] OR phase 3[ti])), 6 trials. CagriSema: the three REIMAGINE phase 3 trials published in PubMed by 2026-10-01 (REIMAGINE 1-3); REIMAGINE 5 has sponsor topline only and is not admitted.
